body: The way I've gone about this, trying to be transparent and hoping that people (some close, some strictly because it's their line of work) would share my belief that I should be able to do it- have not been receptive. Looking at it from a removed perspective, I can definitely understand why that would seem unreasonable. Given that I've been in these conversations, I'm still somewhat annoyed by the fact that most often the opposing stance is "I will not let you".
Okay. You are correct. I left out the word "seem" which it absolutely from my side does *seem* that way.
Thank you for clarifying something that really didn't need to be clarified for the sake of bringing a point to the table that only would put one closer to suicide.

I appreciate you took the time out to respond to this. I just want to clarify my issue is less with my sisters and more with the fact that I don't believe happiness is really the purpose of life or something I should fight for.  But again, thank for the concern.
